up: Return a list of activity rows for compounds tested against the target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2039 (human amine oxidase [flavin-containing] B). For each result, provide the IC50 value in nM, the compound's ChEMBL ID, the canonical SMILES, the compound key, and the PubMed ID or DOI if available. Use the standard IC50 values and standard units.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  activities.standard_value AS ic50_nM,
  molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  compound_structures.canonical_smiles,
  compound_records.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(docs.pubmed_id AS TEXT), docs.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities
JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records ON activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id
LEFT JOIN docs ON activities.doc_id = docs.doc_id
WHERE
  target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2039'
  AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND activities.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND activities.standard_relation = '=';
